pairs: She has not heeded the voice,
She has not trusted in the Lord;
she did not draw near to her God.
Principes ejus in medio ejus quasi leones rugientes;
Her leaders are in her midst like roaring lions.
they leave nothing for the morning.
Her priests have polluted what is holy;
they have acted unjustly against the law.
Dominus justus in medio ejus non faciet iniquitatem;
The just Lord is in their midst; he will not do iniquity. In the morning,
mane, mane judicium suum dabit in lucem,
in the morning, he will bring his judgment into the light,
and it will not be hidden.
But the impious one has not known shame.
and their towers have been torn down.
I have made their ways deserts,
until there were none who passed through.
And her dwelling place will not perish,
propter omnia in quibus visitavi eam:
despite all the things about which I have visited her.
verumtamen diluculo surgentes corruperunt omnes cogitationes suas.
Yet truly, they arose with the dawn and corrupted all their thoughts.
in die resurrectionis meæ in futurum:
in the day of my resurrection in the future,
quia judicium meum ut congregem gentes,
for my judgment is to gather together the Gentiles,
et colligam regna, et effundam super eos indignationem meam,
and to collect the kingdoms, and to pour out over them my indignation,
all the fury of my anger.
in igne enim zeli mei devorabitur omnis terra.
For by the fire of my zeal, all the earth will be devoured.
Quia tunc reddam populis labium electum,
For then I will restore to the people a chosen lip,
ut invocent omnes in nomine Domini,
so that all may invoke the name of the Lord
and may serve him with one shoulder.
Ultra flumina Æthiopiæ, inde supplices mei;
From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia, my supplicants,
filii dispersorum meorum deferent munus mihi.
the sons of my diaspora, will carry a gift to me.
In die illa non confunderis super cunctis adinventionibus tuis,
In that day, you will not be ashamed over all of your inventions,
by which you have transgressed against me.
quia tunc auferam de medio tui magniloquos superbiæ tuæ,
For then I will take away from your midst your arrogant boasters,
et non adjicies exaltari amplius in monte sancto meo.
and you will no longer be exalted on my holy mountain.
Et derelinquam in medio tui populum pauperem et egenum:
And I will bequeath into your midst a poor and needy people,
and they will hope in the name of the Lord.
The remnant of Israel will not do iniquity,
et non invenietur in ore eorum lingua dolosa,
and a deceitful tongue will not be found in their mouth.
and there will be no one to strike them with terror.
and exult with all your heart,
The Lord has taken away your judgment;
he has turned aside your foes.
Rex Israël Dominus in medio tui:
The king of Israel, the Lord, is in your midst;
you shall no longer fear evil.
In that day, it will be said to Jerusalem,
and to Zion, “Do not let your hands be weakened.”
Dominus Deus tuus in medio tui fortis,
The Lord your God is the strength in your midst;
ipse salvabit: gaudebit super te in lætitia,
he will save. He will rejoice over you with gladness.
In his love, he will be silent.
He will exult over you with praise.
The triflers who withdrew from the law,
ut non ultra habeas super eis opprobrium.
so that you may no longer suffer disgrace over them.
Ecce ego interficiam omnes qui afflixerunt te in tempore illo:
I will execute all who have afflicted you in that time,
et eam quæ ejecta fuerat congregabo:
and I will save those who are lame,
and I will gather together her who had been cast out.
And I will place them in praise and in renown,
in all the land where they had been put to shame,
in tempore illo quo adducam vos,
in that time, when I will lead to you,
et in tempore quo congregabo vos.
and in the time when I will gather for you.
Dabo enim vos in nomen, et in laudem omnibus populis terræ,
For I will deliver you into renown and into praise, among all the peoples of the earth,
cum convertero captivitatem vestram coram oculis vestris,
when I will have converted your captivity before your very eyes,
